name: TOOL
description: A tool the model can call. One required action, `call`: the model's arguments in, one uniform result out. The tool's name, description and argument schema are NOT declared here — they live in the `tool` block on the implementing plugin's `call` action, the manifest being the single source of truth (see docs/SPI.md). This contract fixes only what every tool has in common: the action name and the result shape.

call.description: Execute the tool once with model-supplied arguments.

input.description: The arguments of one tool call, shaped by the implementing action's own `tool.parameters` schema — which is why this contract cannot close the object. Gwead validates no payloads at dispatch; the caller is responsible for checking model-emitted arguments against the declared schema before dispatching.

content.description: The tool result as the model will see it, verbatim.

is_error.description: True when `content` describes a failure the model should react to (file not found, command failed). Infrastructure failures are step errors, not `is_error` results.
